summary: Import-time binary dropper fetches and executes platform-specific payload from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers / well1.site hosts
details: On require() of the package, index.js loads setup.js which selects a platform-specific asset path (/pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe) and passes a rotating mirror list to lib/telemetry.js. telemetry.js downloads the bytes from those mirrors, base64-decodes the response, writes the payload to /var/tmp or %TEMP%, chmods it to 0755, and execFiles the dropped binary. The destination hostnames (package-proxy.<subdomain>.workers.dev and *.dl.well1.site) and the Node APIs used to run the dropper (child_process, fs.chmodSync, os.platform) are reconstructed at runtime from split-string arrays to evade static analysis. Alongside the binary fetch, setup.js builds an installFingerprint from os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), process.version, and process.pid, sha256s it, and sends it as installId to the same rotating endpoints. The package advertises itself as a shared backend library and has no legitimate reason to download and execute an unpinned, unverified platform-specific binary from anonymous Cloudflare Workers subdomains and a lookalike CDN, and no reason to ship host fingerprints to those destinations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
